column1: # Curated conceptual edges for the SAGE context graph.
# Format: <src>|<relation>|<dst>|<note>          (# starts a comment line)
# The graph's STRUCTURAL backbone (units, claims, artifacts, configs, findings and their
# cross-references) is EXTRACTED FROM THE REPO by docs/context_graph.py — never hand-edit
# that. This file holds only edges no parser can infer: which theory motivates which
# instrument, what supersedes what, which surface serves which reading.
# Relations must come from the closed set in context_graph.py RELATIONS, or the build
# skips the line and reports it. Corrected from six agent reports; the library is
# `strataq`, never `thermoqre` or `sage` (the research docs use the old name).
concept:logit-qre|DEFINES|concept:precision-lambda|sigma proportional to exp(lambda U); lambda is precision, inverse information cost
concept:strategic-resolvent|DERIVES_FROM|concept:logit-qre|differentiating the fixed point gives chi_eq = (I-SB)^-1 S
concept:reciprocity-defect-R|DERIVES_FROM|concept:strategic-resolvent|R = ||chi-chi^T||/||chi+chi^T||, zero iff the normalised game is potential
concept:reciprocity-defect-R|MEASURES|concept:harmonic-fraction-alpha|Spearman rho(R, alpha) = 0.982 at n=2000
concept:harmonic-fraction-alpha|DEFINES|concept:potentiality-spectrum|Candogan flow decomposition on the NORMALISED game
concept:no-hopf-in-potential|DERIVES_FROM|concept:strategic-resolvent|SB similar to symmetric implies real spectrum implies no Hopf
concept:glauber-dynamics|DEFINES|concept:detailed-balance|potential games are reversible with Gibbs stationary distribution
concept:schnakenberg-epr|MEASURES|concept:irreversibility|exact entropy production, zero iff detailed balance
concept:hatano-sasa-split|DEFINES|concept:housekeeping-vs-excess|sigma_tot = sigma_hk + sigma_ex; housekeeping vanishes iff detailed balance
